answer_1.quote: We use the Stanford Sentiment Treebank Binary (SST-2) as the primary dataset for our explainability experiments in sentiment analysis... additional datasets include Hate Speech Detection (ETHOS) and Duplicated-Question Recognition (QQP).

answer_2.quote: Pinpoint SFT achieves a 14.99% average improvement across NLP datasets, outperforming Full SFT... Accuracy ... reported for SST2, ETHOS, QQP, RTE and MMLU.
